decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management is a strategic option in an uncertain offshore energy market, and keeping it costs little given the firm's existing maritime resources.
Crew and corporate travel management complements the core crew services, has low marginal cost, and remains an option worth holding.
The online portal is a digital option whose value is still uncertain, and the firm holds few other options, so it is kept despite limited visibility.
The mobile app offers potential performance insights, and its carrying cost is manageable, so the option is retained while uncertainty remains.
